restaurantName: Altes Rathaus by What the Food
bio: A truly delightful example of casual, down-to-earth dining that brings pleasure and joy! This restaurant is housed in a picturesque half-timbered house in the pedestrian area. The interior is modern and minimalist, and outside there is a charming terrace overlooking the forecourt. Chef-patron Patrick Schubert cooks up dishes that are creative and full of flavour – opt for his ambitious signature set menu (Da kommsch rum) or choose from the somewhat simpler à la carte selection. Options are more limited at lunchtime. Friendly and competent service comes courtesy of maître d' Anne Henrichs. Good to know: they have a food truck that can be booked for special occasions....
pageTitle: Altes Rathaus by What the Food
